open_points.subject: import confirmation after an identical re-upload
open_points.text: A13 binds an import confirmation only to the file's digest and inputs, while A16 requires confirmation after any replacement upload to be refused, “also when the new file has the same bytes”; no stored upload identity or generation distinguishes those files.
open_points.question: How does Registry distinguish the upload for which confirmation was shown from a later upload with identical bytes, and does that later upload invalidate the pending confirmation?
options: Every accepted upload clears the pending confirmation.
Each upload has a session-local generation or identity included in the confirmation binding.
An identical re-upload does not invalidate confirmation, contrary to A16's rule and required test.
open_points.default_guess: Clear the pending confirmation whenever an upload is accepted.

witness.initial: One owner session holds uploaded file F and a pending import confirmation C bound to digest(F), the selected projects and mapping inputs; no migration closure exists.
events: The owner uploads F again in the same session with exactly the same bytes.
The owner submits the still-pending confirmation value C.
outcomes: A16's replacement rule and required test refuse the submission because the file for which C was shown was replaced.
The digest-based binding in A13 and the stated M11 facts find the same digest and inputs with C still pending, so the import is accepted.
witness.observer: The owner sees refusal versus a successful import; the store, migration closure and audit log also differ.
